newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia bank collusion report due next week - govt.
newsitem.headline: Australia bank collusion report due next week - govt.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday he expected the country's anti-monopolies authority to report on its investigation into possible bank collusion on interest rates by early next week.
The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) said earlier on Monday it would investigate whether the main banks colluded in deciding to cut lending rates.
"The chairman of the ACCC will report to me I hope by early next week on the basis of his investigations," Costello said.
